rationale: The agent did not complete the user’s multi-step request. It failed to provide the price of the specific Bluetooth speaker or its battery life, did not assess whether the price exceeded $300, did not process or even attempt the requested cancellation or substitution steps, did not check for under-$100 alternatives or add the cheapest one, and did not confirm a revised total. Instead, it only reported the total of the current pending order and suggested reaching out later, contrary to the user’s instructions. Required confirmations for order-changing actions were never initiated because the actions weren’t attempted. Overall, the outcome does not meet the pass bar.
